summary: Omega Healthcare Investors Inc. filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, where all director nominees were elected, Ernst & Young LLP was ratified as auditor, and executive compensation received advisory approval. The filing also updates beneficial ownership information due to Vanguard Group's internal realignment and subsequent disaggregated filings showing over 5% ownership. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring occurred; this is routine disclosure.
